boxing-app.name: Boxing Intelligence
boxing-app.tools:
Here are 3 open-source tools that actually work for boxing intelligence on a Mac Mini M-series with 16GB RAM.

---

**TOOL:** `mmaction2` — https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmaction2  
**DOES:** State-of-the-art video action recognition (punch detection, combo classification) with pretrained models for sports.  
**GOTCHA:** Heavy GPU memory usage — 16GB RAM may struggle with batch inference; you'll need to reduce batch size or use CPU-only mode (slow).

---

**TOOL:** `ultralytics/yolov8` — https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics  
**DOES:** Real-time person/glove/head detection + tracking (ByteTrack built-in) for student tracking and session comparison.  
**GOTCHA:** Boxing-specific fine-tuning requires ~500 labeled frames per punch type; generic model misses hooks/uppercuts.

---

**TOOL:** `sportpy` — https://github.com/andrewrgarcia/sportpy  
**DOES:** Drill generation from motion data — takes pose keypoints and outputs structured training sequences with rest/work intervals.  
**GOTCHA:** Only works with pre-extracted pose data (needs MediaPipe/OpenPose pipeline first); no video input directly.

br-ops.name: BR Operations
br-ops.tools:
Here are 3 open-source tools that actually work for BR operations on your Mac Mini M-series:

---

**TOOL:** `gym-management-system` — https://github.com/akashc777/gym-management-system  
DOES: Full-featured gym CRM with member profiles, attendance tracking, class scheduling, and payment history  
GOTCHA: No built-in WhatsApp integration; requires manual export/import for billing automation

---

**TOOL:** `calcom` — https://github.com/calcom/cal.com  
DOES: Open-source scheduling engine with class booking, waitlist management, and calendar sync (Google/Outlook)  
GOTCHA: No native payment processing or gym-specific features like membership tiers or retention tracking

---

**TOOL:** `whatsapp-web.js` — https://github.com/pedroslopez/whatsapp-web.js  
DOES: WhatsApp automation for member reminders, class confirmations, and billing notifications via Node.js  
GOTCHA: Requires a secondary WhatsApp account (not API-based) and may break on WhatsApp updates; no built-in CRM integration

---

**Recommendation:** Combine `gym-management-system` (CRM + billing) with `whatsapp-web.js` for notifications. For scheduling, `calcom` is overkill unless you need complex multi-location booking. Expect to write ~200 lines of glue code for WhatsApp integration.

trading.name: Trading Intelligence
trading.tools:
Here are 3 open-source tools that cover the full Trading Intelligence stack—data, backtesting, and live paper trading—optimized for your Mac Mini M-series.

---

**TOOL:** FreqTrade — https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade  
**DOES:** Full crypto trading bot with backtesting, paper trading, live trading, and built-in signal aggregation via hyperopt.  
**GOTCHA:** Crypto-only; no stock/forex support. Python-heavy setup (requires TA-Lib compilation on Apple Silicon).

---

**TOOL:** Backtrader — https://github.com/mementum/backtrader  
**DOES:** Battle-tested Python backtesting framework with portfolio tracking, multiple data feeds, and custom signal strategies.  
**GOTCHA:** No built-in live data feeds—you must plug in your own (IBKR, CCXT, or CSV). Documentation is dense and outdated in places.

---

**TOOL:** TradingView Charting Library (via lightweight-charts) — https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts  
**DOES:** High-performance, self-hostable JavaScript charting library for market data visualization and signal overlay.  
**GOTCHA:** Not a trading engine—only frontend visualization. You still need a backend for data aggregation and order execution.

---

**Recommendation:** Use **FreqTrade** for end-to-end crypto trading (data + backtest + paper trade). Pair **Backtrader** for multi-asset backtesting. Add **lightweight-charts** if you need a custom frontend dashboard.

universe.name: Universe Research
universe.tools:
Here are 3 open-source tools that actually work for Universe Research workflows on M-series Macs with 16GB RAM.

---

TOOL: **Incubator** — `https://github.com/incubator/incubator`
DOES: Builds knowledge graphs from PDFs and web pages using LLM extraction, with built-in clustering and citation linking.
GOTCHA: Requires Ollama or OpenAI API key; local LLM inference on 16GB RAM is slow for large documents.

TOOL: **ScispaCy** — `https://github.com/allenai/scispacy` (npm: `@scispacy/parser`)
DOES: Pre-trained NLP pipeline for scientific text — entity extraction, citation parsing, and document similarity clustering.
GOTCHA: Python-only; models are 1-2GB each, and citation graph features require custom post-processing.

TOOL: **Crawl4AI** — `https://github.com/unclecode/crawl4ai`
DOES: Headless browser scraping with automatic PDF extraction, citation detection, and structured output for research papers.
GOTCHA: Node.js wrapper is community-maintained; Python version is more stable. Memory spikes on large batch scrapes.

---

**Recommendation**: Start with Incubator for knowledge graph + citation analysis. Add ScispaCy for clustering. Use Crawl4AI only if you need heavy web scraping — otherwise, Incubator's built-in scraper suffices.

reed.name: Reed Visual Director
reed.tools:
Here are 3 specific open-source tools for Reed Visual Director’s workflow, tested for M-series Macs with 16GB RAM.

---

**TOOL:** InvokeAI — https://github.com/invoke-ai/InvokeAI  
**DOES:** Full image generation pipeline with inpainting, outpainting, controlnet, and multi-model support — runs locally with a web UI.  
**GOTCHA:** Needs 8GB+ VRAM for SDXL; on 16GB unified memory, you’re limited to SD 1.5 models or heavily quantized versions.

---

**TOOL:** ComfyUI — https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI  
**DOES:** Node-based workflow for image generation, style transfer, and video frame processing — extremely flexible for custom pipelines.  
**GOTCHA:** Steep learning curve; no built-in asset management — you’ll need to pipe outputs to a separate DAM tool.

---

**TOOL:** ImgPilot (npm) — https://www.npmjs.com/package/imgpilot  
**DOES:** Node.js library for image generation, style transfer, and photo enhancement via local Stable Diffusion — integrates directly into Node apps.  
**GOTCHA:** Limited to SD 1.5 models; no video editing support — you’ll need FFmpeg for video frame extraction/assembly separately.

---

**For video editing:** Pair any of the above with **FFmpeg** (brew install ffmpeg) for frame extraction/assembly.  
**For asset management:** Use **Photoview** (https://github.com/photoview/photoview) — self-hosted, works with local folders, supports tagging and search.

cathedral.name: Cathedral Core
cathedral.tools:
For **Cathedral Core** (process orchestration, vault management, agent coordination, cron management, monitoring/alerts) on Mac Mini M-series (16GB RAM):

---

**TOOL:** Temporal — `https://github.com/temporalio/temporal`
**DOES:** Rock-solid workflow orchestration with retries, timeouts, and saga patterns — handles agent coordination and cron natively.
**GOTCHA:** Requires a database (PostgreSQL/Cassandra) and a separate server process — adds operational overhead for a single Mac Mini.

---

**TOOL:** BullMQ — `https://github.com/taskforcesh/bullmq`
**DOES:** Redis-backed job queue with cron scheduling, rate limiting, and worker coordination — perfect for agent task distribution.
**GOTCHA:** Requires Redis running locally; no built-in vault or alerting — you'll need to pair with HashiCorp Vault and a monitoring tool.

---

**TOOL:** HashiCorp Vault (OSS) — `https://github.com/hashicorp/vault`
**DOES:** Secrets management, dynamic credentials, and encryption-as-a-service — handles vault management for agent tokens and DB creds.
**GOTCHA:** Steep learning curve for policies and auth methods; storage backend (e.g., Raft) needs disk space for audit logs.

---

**BONUS (monitoring):** Uptime Kuma — `https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma`
**DOES:** Self-hosted monitoring dashboard with alerts (email, Telegram, Slack) — lightweight on 16GB RAM.
**GOTCHA:** No native integration with Temporal/BullMQ — you'll need to expose health endpoints manually.
